page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, and it is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of this instance type is its integrated local storage capacity. It includes 70,866 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage, making it suitable for applications requiring large-scale sequential data access. The network interface supports a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps, facilitating data transfer rates aligned with the storage throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1.6xlarge utilizes mechanical HDD storage rather than solid-state drives. This design choice offers a high volume of storage capacity per unit of cost, though it introduces a performance tradeoff in terms of random input/output operations per second (IOPS) compared to SSD-backed instances. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention.

This hardware profile is designed for workloads that process large volumes of cold or warm data. Suitable use cases include distributed file systems, big data analytics frameworks, log processing, and data warehousing where sequential read and write performance is prioritized over low-latency random access.
